discovery_method: Live web search of operator, government, university and specialist publications; finite reviewed seed catalog
scores_are: Editorial 1-5 assessments of potential, not proof that an unselected topic is fully verified

candidates.title: How a bullet train can brake before strong shaking

candidates.title: Why Japan's electricity has two frequencies

candidates.title: Koji makes enzymes that turn starch into sugars

candidates.title: Naruto's whirlpools are driven by tidal level differences

candidates.title: Japanese scripts do different jobs in the same sentence

candidates.title: The lacquer joins the pottery; the gold decorates the repair
